# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
We release patches for security vulnerabilities. Which versions are eligible for receiving such patches?

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.4.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.4   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability
The team takes security seriously. If you discover a security issue, please bring it to our attention ASAP!

**Please DO NOT file a public issue.** Instead, email us at [your-email@example.com] or use the GitHub Security Advisories feature.

## Preferred Languages
We prefer all communications to be in English.
